reviews.title: Disaster
reviews.text: The camera records images in good quality. However, when an accident occurs, the recording stops for 24 hours before the accident, and you won't be able to access the cable or press any buttons. As a result, you won't have any images. The moment of the accident is lost. I have contacted the camera seller and the App Store for assistance, but there is no help available. During an accident, you will lose a significant amount of money due to the camera and digital support not functioning properly. Yes, this is a very bad camera. With the shock sensor turned on, in case of an emergency or accident, the camera stops recording altogether and does not start recording until you turn it on so that it records. So this camera did not record two emergency braking situations, nor did it record the accident when my car was hit. She writes well, but when there are emergencies or an accident, she stops writing and this information is missing from the memory card. If you want, I can send you this camera in exchange for a serviceable one. And you explore it as much as you want. Sincerely,
